Preloader.title: Welcome to BistroMapa!
Preloader.subtitle: Before we begin, tell us where you are looking for food.

Home.support-desc: Our goal is to create a dedicated mobile app to make discovering the best dishes in your area easier. Help us achieve this goal! Every bit of support brings us closer to releasing the app.
Home.today-offer-desc: Browse the latest daily menus and lunch offers from local restaurants, automatically collected directly from their social media posts.
Home.last-update: Daily automatic offer fetch at 12:00 PM.

Home.no-dishes-today: It looks like no dishes have been fetched for today yet. Please check back after 12:00 PM.
Home.official-ranking-desc: Top-rated and most popular venues in the system
Home.about-service-desc: Our smart system checks Facebook posts of leading restaurants, analyzing content to find today's lunch deals and daily specials. Offers are updated automatically. If you run a restaurant and want to be listed, create an account and add your social media profile.

For-restaurants.title1: 1. Create an account and submit a venue
For-restaurants.desc1: Register as an Owner, fill in the details, and paste your Facebook page URL.
For-restaurants.desc2: The bot scans posts daily at 12:00 PM. To ensure fetching, publish your post before 11:00 AM.
For-restaurants.desc3: Your Facebook post must start with the text 'Daily Dish!' – without emojis or leading spaces.
For-restaurants.desc4: You get a 30-day free trial. Afterwards, the BASE plan cost is 100 PLN per month.
For-restaurants.question: Are you sure you want to revoke grace period and restore this account along with all venues?
For-restaurants.question2: Delete review and ban author for 3 days?
For-restaurants.question3: Suspend this venue and block the owner?
For-restaurants.admin-panel-description: Approve applications from restaurateurs, manage venue activity, control statuses, and moderate reports.
For-restaurants.owner-panel-description: Manage your venues, track views, and control subscription status.
For-restaurants.user-profile-description: Manage your settings, browse favorite restaurants, and track posted reviews.
For-restaurants.dedicated-panel-description: Join the BistroMapa platform and reach hundreds of hungry customers in your area.
For-restaurants.account-in-removal-description: Owners who submitted account deletion requests. Their venues have been suspended (REMOVAL status) and hidden. During the 3-month grace period, you can restore their accounts and venues to full activity with one click.
For-restaurants.no-removal-accounts: No accounts pending deletion in grace period.
For-restaurants.restore-period-account: Revoke grace period and restore account
For-restaurants.any-assigned-restaurants: You don't have any restaurants assigned to this account yet.

For-restaurants.local-create-desc: Separate with commas. Affects catalog categories and SEO.
For-restaurants.create-info-desc: The site administrator will verify your proof of ownership and approve the venue application within 24-48 hours.
For-restaurants.abonaments-yr-desc: Control subscription statuses and activate promotional modules for each of your venues.
For-restaurants.submit-one: Submit at least one restaurant to purchase a subscription.
For-restaurants.base-plan-price-desc: Everything your restaurant needs for a full presence on BistroMapa:
For-restaurants.base-plan-list1: Full venue profile (photos, description, contact, location)
For-restaurants.base-plan-list2: Fetching daily dishes from Facebook (FB bot scraper at 12:00 PM)
For-restaurants.base-plan-list4: Permanent Offer management (displayed when no new FB post is available)
For-restaurants.promotion-plan-desc: Promote your restaurant higher in search results and attract more hungry customers:
For-restaurants.promotion-plan-list1: Priority over standard results within 30 km (at the very top of the list)
For-restaurants.promotion-plan-list2: Visual highlight on the map and in the restaurant list
For-restaurants.payment-history-desc: No payment history on this account.

For-restaurants.profile-settings-desc: Manage your personal data and billing/residence address.
For-restaurants.nip-info: Tax ID is already linked to this account and cannot be edited.
For-restaurants.danger-zone-info1: Deleting a restaurant account will immediately suspend your venues and cancel subscriptions for a 3-month grace period.
For-restaurants.danger-zone-info2: Account deletion is irreversible and will delete your profile and reviews.
For-restaurants.join-us-desc: Submit your venue, track visits, add menus, and gain free customers today!
